services.name: Group Lessons
services.desc: Our Parent/Child classes are for water acclimation of swimmers from 6 months to 3 years of age. We have 8-10 parent child pairs per class and do a mix of songs, activities, and instruction to gain comfort and swimming readiness. Parents accompany children in Parent/Child A, which introduces infants and toddlers to the aquatic environment through exploration. The course encourages children to enjoy themselves while learning about the water. Parents accompany their toddlers in Parent/Child B and work with their children to explore body positions, floating, blowing bubbles, and fundamental safety and aquatics skills. services.name: Youth Boxing
services.desc: The Cambridge Police Youth Boxing & Fitness Program is a collaboration between the Cambridge Police Family Social Justice Section & the Cambridge YMCA. Starting in 2011, it has become a staple of the Cambridge community and a flagship program of the Cambridge Police Department. Run by a Cambridge Police Officer, a Cambridge Police Department Social Worker, and with assistance from YMCA staff, we are a gender inclusive, non-contact, fitness based boxing program for Cambridge youth in grades 6-12. We focus on: Self defense, physical & mental health, peer mentor-ship, relationship building, family support, social emotional learning, inclusion, individual growth in a group setting,

services.name: Swim Lessons
services.desc: Build skills and confidence with personalized, one-on-one swim lessons for all abilities. Whether you’re a beginner or looking to improve your strokes, you’ll be matched with an instructor who fits your needs. Lessons are 60 minutes long and offered year-round during our scheduled six-week sessions. Available for youth (ages 6+), teens, and adults. Designed for our youngest swimmers, the 30-minute one-on-one lessons help children ages 3-6 build water confidence and basic swim skills in a safe, supportive environment.
